title: The Lob (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-folk 104 bpm bright acoustic guitar light snare warm bass hand claps mellow horn light Spanish phrase accent uplifting drilling cadence pickleball training song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the kitchen line is full
Lob it up and feel the pull
Deep deep deep over the head
Reclaim the back court instead

[Pre-Chorus]
Lob lob lob lob
Up and over tall
Lob lob lob lob
Float the high ball

[Chorus]
This is the lob shot high and deep
Over the shoulder soft and steep
Lob lob lob lob aim for the line
Lob lob lob lob take your time take your time

[Verse 2]
Disguise it like a soft drop
Then lift it up and let it pop
Wind up small follow up tall
Let the lob make the call

[Bridge]
Use it sparing use it smart
When the moment plays its part
Deep depth deep depth deep
Over the head let it leap

[Outro]
Lob lob lob high and deep
Lob lob lob steady leap
